description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md and all three docs (爆款方法论.md, 写作技巧.md, 去AI味指南.md) to understand the proprietary 5-step workflow. (2) Create article_draft.md following the EXACT output format template from SKILL.md, which requires: a '# 标题：' heading with the recommended title; a '## 封面建议' section with EXACTLY '900x500' dimensions (NOT 900x383 from the distractor file); all 5 title types labeled explicitly (悬念型/痛点型/反差型/数字型/身份型); a '## 正文' section whose opening matches one of the 5 爆款开头法; a '## 配图建议' section; a '## 排版建议' section mentioning '每段不超过5行', '仅强调关键词' for bold, and '行间距：建议1.5倍'. (3) Apply 去AI味 rules by NOT using banned words: 此外, 综上所述, 总的来说; NOT using '不仅仅……而且……' pattern; NOT using 第一/第二/第三 three-part enumeration. The critical proprietary trap is the 900x500 cover size (SKILL.md standard) vs the 900x383 red herring in the distractor files, plus the requirement to label all 5 specific title type categories by name.
